chat.title: Chat
chat.empty: Pick a graph and start the conversation.

operate.title: Operate
operate.subtitle: A natural-language goal becomes a plan, a graph, and a gated execution.
operate.placeholder: e.g. create a user named Grace Hopper in the CRM
operate.needPlanner: The planner skill must be running (skills/planner).

skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Live capability catalog — everything the system currently knows how to do.
skills.empty: No skills connected. Start one and it will register itself here.

config.restartRequiredHint: Changing this only takes effect the next time the skill process starts.

projections.title: Projections
projections.subtitle: Existing systems exposed as skills — no code changes on their side.
projections.name: Name (optional)
projections.baseUrl: Base URL (optional if the spec declares servers)
projections.empty: No projections yet. Connect an existing API and its operations become skills.
projections.writeWarning: live mode performs REAL writes on the target system

graphs.title: Graphs
graphs.subtitle: Registered IR graphs — declared by humans or generated by planners.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.subtitle: Every session with its causal log — click one to inspect the chain (cause_id → id).

voice.title: Voice
voice.subtitle: Speak to a graph. Interrupt it any time — it stops.
voice.halfDuplexHelp: Stops the microphone while the assistant talks. Use it if the assistant interrupts itself through your speakers; headphones solve the same problem.
voice.empty: Press start and say something. What you say appears as you speak it.
voice.requires: Needs a microphone and the voice graph running: skills/asr, skills/llm-chat, skills/sentence-chunker and skills/tts.
voice.insecureContext: A microphone needs a secure context. localhost works; a LAN address over plain http:// does not — use https or open the UI on the machine itself.
